en:too.enDefinition: Likewise. · Also, in addition marks a statement as equally valid as the preceding one. · To an excessive degree, more than enough indicates that the degree of a quality is more than what is needed or wanted. · To a high degree, very.

en:down.enDefinition: To knock (someone or something) down; to cause to come down; to fell. · Specifically, to cause (something in the air) to fall to the ground; to bring down (with a missile etc.). · To lower; to put (something) down. · To defeat; to overpower.

en:very.enDefinition: To a great extent or degree. · Conforming to fact, reality or rule; true. · Used to firmly establish that nothing else surpasses in some respect.

en:never.definition: asla, hiçbir zaman · hiç · Negatif edat (basit geçmiş zamanda fiilleri olumsuzlamak için kullanılır; absolutely de kullanılır.)
en:never.enDefinition: At no time; on no occasion; in no circumstance. · Not at any other time; not on any other occasion; not previously. · Negative particle (used to negate verbs in the simple past tense; also used absolutely).

en:people.definition: kişinin çoğulu, kişiler · halk · genel anlamda tüm insanlar · (ABD ağzı) mahkemede iddia makamı
en:people.enDefinition: Persons forming or belonging to a particular group, such as a nation, class, ethnic group, country, family, etc. · A group of persons regarded as being servants, followers, companions or subjects of a ruler or leader. · One's colleagues or employees. · A person's ancestors, relatives or family.
en:people.deDefinition: das Volk · die Leute, die Menschen

en:because.enDefinition: By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the reason that. · As is known, inferred, or determined from the fact that.

en:little.enDefinition: Small, not large, limited, particularly · Small, limited in size. · Short, limited in extent. · Brief, limited in duration.

en:please.enDefinition: interjection to make a polite request
en:please.pairedSense: interjection to make a polite request

en:love.definition: sevgi · sevi · aşk · emre · muhabbet · sevda
en:love.deDefinition: Liebe · Zuneigung · Minne · Liäbi · Liebi · Liab

en:said.definition: say (demek) fiilinin geçmiş zaman kipi ve geçmiş zaman sıfat-fiil (3.) hali.
en:said.enDefinition: To pronounce. · To recite. · To tell, either verbally or in writing. · To indicate in a written form.

en:give.enDefinition: To transfer one's possession or holding of (something) to (someone). · To make a present or gift of. · To pledge. · To provide (something) to (someone), to allow or afford.

en:off.definition: uzağa, dışına · başka istikamete · çalışmaz durumda, kapalı (elektrikli aletler ve makineler için) · yolculuğa başlamış, yola çıkmış
en:off.enDefinition: In a direction away from the speaker or other reference point. · Into a state of non-operation or non-existence. · So as to remove or separate, or be removed or separated. · Specifying the number of some item in bills, parts lists, etc.

en:am.enDefinition: used to indicate that the subject has the qualities described by an adjective
en:am.pairedSense: used to indicate that the subject has the qualities described by an adjective

en:thank.enDefinition: To express appreciation or gratitude toward (someone or something). · In the future tense in the form one will thank someone to do something, chiefly expressing a command or criticism: to request that (someone) do something. · To respond to (someone) out of, or as if out of, appreciation or gratitude. · Chiefly followed by for: to credit or hold (someone or something) responsible, especially for something negative; to blame.

en:any.enDefinition: To even the slightest extent; at all. · Used before different, before comparatives with more and less, and idiomatically before other comparatives, generally in interrogative, hypothetical, or negative contexts. · Used to modify a verb, generally a finite verb or a non-finite verb in object position.

en:two.enDefinition: A numerical value equal to 2; the number following one and preceding three. · Describing a set or group with two elements.

en:much.enDefinition: To a great extent. · for emphasis or to indicate a great difference · Often; frequently. · Used to indicate or compare extent.

en:sure.definition: (bir şeyin doğruluğundan) emin. · şüpheye mahal bırakmayan, kat'î, kesin.
en:sure.enDefinition: Physically secure and certain, non-failing, reliable. · Certain in one's knowledge or belief. · Certain to act or be a specified way. · Certain to obtain something.

en:thing.enDefinition: That which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept. · A word, symbol, sign, or other referent that can be used to refer to any entity. · An individual object or distinct entity. · Whatever can be owned.
en:thing.deDefinition: ein materielles Objekt, ohne Bewusstsein · ein Wesen oder eine Existenz die nicht näher spezifiziert oder genau beschrieben werden kann · eine Angelegenheit, Anliegen, Problem oder Faktor · eine Handlung, Tat oder ein Verhalten

en:help.enDefinition: Action given to provide assistance; aid. · Something or someone which provides assistance with a task. · Documentation provided with computer software that could be accessed using the computer. · A study aid.
en:help.deDefinition: Hilfe · Hilfsmittel, Mittel · Dienstmädchen, Mädchen · Aushilfe, Hilfskraft

en:first.enDefinition: Preceding all others of a series or kind; the ordinal of one; earliest. · Most eminent or exalted; most excellent; chief; highest. · Of or belonging to a first family. · Coming right after the zeroth in things that use zero-based numbering.

en:into.enDefinition: To or towards the inside of. · To or towards the region of. · To the condition or state. · Against, especially with force or violence.
en:into.deDefinition: in etwasᴬᵏᵏ hinein · eine Zahl in Teile zerlegen: in

en:anything.enDefinition: Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatsoever; a thing of any kind; something or other. · Expressing an indefinite comparison.

en:still.definition: derin sessizlik ve sakinlik · hareketsiz fotoğraf, genellikle bir film karesi.
en:still.enDefinition: A period of calm or silence. · A photograph, as opposed to movie footage. · A single frame from a film. · A resident of the Falkland Islands.

en:find.enDefinition: To encounter or discover by accident; to happen upon. · To encounter or discover something being searched for; to locate. · To locate on behalf of another. · To discover by study or experiment directed to an object or end.
en:find.deDefinition: etwas oder jemanden finden · etwas herausfinden · etwas auftreiben oder aufbringen

en:sir.enDefinition: A man of a higher rank or position. · A respectful term of address to a man of higher rank or position, particularly · to a knight or other low member of the peerage. · to a superior military officer.
en:sir.deDefinition: formelle, höfliche, respektvolle Anrede eines Mannes ohne seinen Namen

en:work.enDefinition: intransitive: to do a specific task
en:work.pairedSense: intransitive: to do a specific task

en:their.definition: onların · Kullanım ve çekim bağlama göre değişir.
en:their.enDefinition: Belonging to, from, of, or relating to, them (plural). · Belonging to someone (one person, singular), or occasionally to something.
en:their.deDefinition: ihr · Die Form hängt vom Satzkontext ab.

en:uh.enDefinition: Expression of thought, confusion, or uncertainty. · Expression of discomfort or reservation; a hesitation preceding awkward information or innuendo. · Space filler or pause during conversation.

en:again.definition: bir defa daha, tekrar, yeniden · buna ilaveten · önceki ifadeyi destekleyen ya da tezat meydana getiren bir noktayı belirtmek için kullanılır. buna ilaveten, bir de şunu belirtmek gerekirse.
en:again.enDefinition: Another time: indicating a repeat of an action. · Back (to a former place or state). · Over and above a factor of one. · Used metalinguistically, with the repetition being in the discussion, or in the linguistic or pragmatic context of the discussion, rather than in the subject of discussion.
en:again.deDefinition: ein weiteres Mal; wieder, nochmals, erneut, noch einmal

en:maybe.enDefinition: Perhaps, possibly. · Perhaps that is true (expressing no commitment to a decision or a neutral viewpoint to a statement). · Certainly.

en:must.enDefinition: To do as a requirement; indicates that the sentence subject is required as an imperative or directive to execute the sentence predicate, with failure to do so resulting in a failure or negative consequence. · To do with certainty; indicates that the speaker is certain that the subject will have executed the predicate. · Used to indicate that something is very likely, probable, or certain to be true.

en:before.enDefinition: Earlier than (in time). · In front of in space. · In the presence of. · Under consideration, judgment, authority of (someone).
en:before.deDefinition: vor (zeitlich) · vor (räumlich) (eher veraltet, bzw. nur bei feierlichen Anlässen; mehr gebräuchlich ist: in front of) · vor (in einer Abfolge)

en:other.enDefinition: See other (determiner) below. · Second. · Alien. · Different.

en:wait.enDefinition: To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness. · To wait tables; to serve customers in a restaurant or other eating establishment. · To remain faithful to one’s partner or betrothed during a prolonged period of absence.

en:stop.enDefinition: A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station. · An action of stopping; interruption of travel. · That which stops, impedes, or obstructs; an obstacle; an impediment. · A device intended to block the path of a moving object
en:stop.deDefinition: Haltestelle · Pause, Unterbrechung · Stoppball (kurz hinter das Netz geschlagener Ball) · Verschlusslaut

en:call.enDefinition: To request, summon, or beckon. · To cry or shout. · To utter in a loud or distinct voice. · To contact by telephone.

en:after.enDefinition: subsequently; following in time; later than
en:after.pairedSense: subsequently; following in time; later than

en:talk.enDefinition: A conversation or discussion; usually serious, but informal. · A lecture. · Gossip; rumour. · A major topic of social discussion.
en:talk.deDefinition: Reden, Geschwafel · Gespräch, Unterhaltung, Plauderei, Unterredung, Besprechung · (meist kurzer) Vortrag

en:away.enDefinition: From a place, hence. · Aside; off; in another direction. · Aside, so as to discard something. · At a stated distance in time or space.

en:than.enDefinition: Used in comparisons, to introduce the basis of comparison.
en:than.deDefinition: als (Konnektor bei Ungleichem beziehungsweise zwischen den Vergleichsstücken im Vergleich)

en:thought.enDefinition: A representation created in the mind without the use of one's faculties of vision, sound, smell, touch, or taste; an instance of thinking. · The operation by which mental activity arise or are manipulated; the process of thinking; the agency by which thinking is accomplished. · A way of thinking (associated with a group, nation, region or idea). · Anxiety, distress.

en:home.enDefinition: house or structure in which someone lives — see also domicile, dwelling, abode
en:home.pairedSense: house or structure in which someone lives — see also domicile, dwelling, abode

en:night.enDefinition: The time when the Sun is below the horizon when the sky is dark. · The period of darkness beginning at the end of evening astronomical twilight when the sun is 18 degrees below the horizon, and ending at the beginning of morning astronomical twilight. · A period of time often defined in the legal system as beginning 30 minutes after sunset, and ending 30 minutes before sunrise. · An evening or night spent at a particular activity.
en:night.deDefinition: Nacht · Abend, an dem man ausgeht

en:put.enDefinition: To physically place (sth or sb swh). · To place in abstract; to attach or attribute; to assign. · To bring or set (into a certain relation, state or condition). · To express (something in a certain manner).

en:great.enDefinition: Expression of gladness and content about something. · A sarcastic inversion thereof.

en:those.enDefinition: The (thing, person, idea, etc) indicated or understood from context, especially if more remote physically, temporally or mentally than one designated as “this”, or if expressing distinction.

en:last.definition: son, biten, sonuncu · bir önceki, geçen, geçtiğimiz
en:last.enDefinition: Final, ultimate, coming after all others of its kind. · Most recent, latest, last so far. · Farthest of all from a given quality, character, or condition; most unlikely, or least preferable. · Being the only one remaining of its class.

en:better.enDefinition: Greater in amount or quantity · Greater or lesser (whichever is seen as more advantageous), in reference to value, distance, time, etc. · Healed or recovered from an injury or illness.

en:everything.definition: birisi için çok önemli olan şeylerin tamamı · her şey, tüm şeyler
en:everything.enDefinition: All the things under discussion. · Many or most things. · A state of well-being (from all parts of the whole). · Considerable effort.

en:told.enDefinition: To determine the number, amount, or value of [something]. · To notice, discern. (Roughly, "can tell" means "know" but with a sense of direct perception.) · To pick up on a difference. (See tell apart for more.) · To narrate, to recount.

en:things.enDefinition: That which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept. · A word, symbol, sign, or other referent that can be used to refer to any entity. · An individual object or distinct entity. · Whatever can be owned.
en:things.deDefinition: ein materielles Objekt, ohne Bewusstsein · ein Wesen oder eine Existenz die nicht näher spezifiziert oder genau beschrieben werden kann · eine Angelegenheit, Anliegen, Problem oder Faktor · eine Handlung, Tat oder ein Verhalten

en:always.definition: daima, nâmütenâhî, sonsuza kadar · her seferinde, her zaman · son çare olarak
en:always.enDefinition: At all times; throughout all time; since the beginning. · Constantly during a certain period, or regularly at stated intervals (opposed to sometimes or occasionally). · if necessary, or if there is no better option; in any event.

en:keep.definition: muhafaza etmek, saklamak · devam ettirmek, sürdürmek, muhafaza etmek (dengesini, faaliyeti vs.) · (birini) (işinden) alıkoymak, oyalamak · korumak, muhafaza etmek (bir yeri, birini).
en:keep.enDefinition: To continue in (a course or mode of action); to not intermit or fall from; to uphold or maintain. · To remain faithful to a given promise or word. · To maintain possession of. · To maintain the condition of; to preserve in a certain state.

en:long.enDefinition: having much distance from one point to another
en:long.pairedSense: having much distance from one point to another

en:years.enDefinition: time it takes for the Earth to complete one revolution around the Sun
en:years.pairedSense: time it takes for the Earth to complete one revolution around the Sun

en:money.enDefinition: A generally accepted means of exchange. · A currency maintained by a state or other entity which can guarantee its value (such as a monetary union). · Hard cash in the form of banknotes and coins, as opposed to cheques, credit cards, or credit more generally. · The total value of liquid assets available for an individual or other economic unit, such as cash and bank deposits.

en:around.enDefinition: Forming a circle or closed curve containing (something). · Centred upon; surrounding; regarding. · Following the perimeter of a specified area and returning to the starting point. · Following a path which curves near an object, with the object on the inside of the curve.

en:name.enDefinition: Any nounal word or phrase which indicates a particular person, place, class, or thing. · A reputation. · An abusive or insulting epithet. · A person (or legal person).

en:place.enDefinition: An open space, particularly a city square, market square, or courtyard. · A street, sometimes but not always surrounding a public place, square, or plaza of the same name. · An inhabited area: a village, town, or city. · Any area of the earth: a region.

en:ever.definition: (olumsuz veya soru cümlelerinde) hiç, hiçbir zaman · şimdiye kadar · her zaman · sürekli, devamlı, artarak
en:ever.enDefinition: Continuously, constantly, all the time (for the complete duration). · At any time. · As intensifier following an interrogative word. · Indicates experiential aspect, once; has or have (done something) before.

en:guys.enDefinition: Used to address a group of people regardless of gender.
en:guys.deDefinition: der Mann · die Männer oder Frauen · britisch: die mit Lumpen bekleidete Puppe zum Verbrennen · die Leine oder Schnur zum Spannen und Halten

en:father.definition: baba · peder, papaz · ata · yaratıcı, kurucu
en:father.enDefinition: A male parent, especially of a human; a male who parents a child (which he has sired, adopted, fostered, etc.). · A male ancestor more remote than a parent; a progenitor; especially, a first ancestor. · A term of respectful address for an elderly man. · A term of respectful address for a priest.
en:father.deDefinition: männlicher Elternteil; Vater · christlicher Geistlicher, Priester · Anrede für einen älteren Mann

en:guy.enDefinition: An effigy of a man burned on a bonfire on the anniversary of the Gunpowder Plot (5th November). · A man or boy; a fellow. · A person (see usage notes). · Anything seen to have character and personality, such as an animal or a toy.
en:guy.deDefinition: der Mann · die Männer oder Frauen · britisch: die mit Lumpen bekleidete Puppe zum Verbrennen · die Leine oder Schnur zum Spannen und Halten

en:old.enDefinition: of an object, concept, etc: having existed for a relatively long period of time
en:old.pairedSense: of an object, concept, etc: having existed for a relatively long period of time

en:which.enDefinition: What, of those mentioned or implied. · The/Any ... that; whichever. · Designates the one(s) previously mentioned.

en:big.enDefinition: Of great size, large. · Fat. · Large with young; pregnant; swelling; ready to give birth or produce. · Specifically, big-breasted.

en:lot.enDefinition: A large quantity or number; a great deal. · A separate, appropriated portion; a quantized, subdivided set consisting a whole. · One or more items auctioned or sold as a unit, separate from other items. · A number of people taken collectively.

en:done.enDefinition: Having completed or finished an activity. · Completed or finished. · Ready, fully cooked. · Being exhausted, used up, or fully spent.

en:hello.deDefinition: hallo · guten Tag · servus · moin · grüß Gott · Tag

en:nice.definition: hoş, kibar, sevimli · faziletli, erdemli · hürmetli, muteber, saygıdeğer, saygın · hatırı sayılır, kayda değer
en:nice.enDefinition: Pleasant, satisfactory, complimentary. · Of a person: friendly, attractive. · Respectable; virtuous. · Shows that the given adjective is desirable, or acts as a mild intensifier; pleasantly, quite.
en:nice.deDefinition: freundlich, lieb, nett, sympathisch · hübsch, nett, schön · angenehm, lecker · geil, schön, super, toll, wunderbar

en:believe.definition: birine inanmak · bir şeyin varlığına inanmak · bir şeye olan inancı tam olmak, birine güvenmek · bir şeyin gerekliliğine inanmak
en:believe.enDefinition: To accept as true, particularly without absolute certainty (i.e., as opposed to knowing). · To accept that someone is telling the truth. · To have been convinced by rational means to accept the truth of a proposition. · To have been influenced by arational means (such as emotional experience, the imagination of need, etc.) to accept the truth of a proposition.
en:believe.deDefinition: etwas glauben · einer Aussage Glauben schenken

en:girl.deDefinition: Mädchen · Mädel · Goof · Maidle · Maitli · Meitle

en:someone.enDefinition: One or some person of unspecified or indefinite identity.
en:someone.deDefinition: eine unbestimmte Person in unverneinten Aussagesätzen

en:fine.definition: az, belli belirsiz · ince · iyi (kaliteli, sağlam, memnun edici, istenen şekilde v.s.) · iyi (sağlığı yerinde v.s.)
en:fine.enDefinition: Of superior quality. · Impressively bad, inappropriate, or unsatisfactory. · Being acceptable, adequate, passable, or satisfactory; having one's well-being be no cause for concern. · Good-looking, attractive.

en:thanks.enDefinition: Used to express appreciation or gratitude.
en:thanks.deDefinition: Ausdruck, um seine Dankbarkeit zu zeigen

en:wanted.enDefinition: Wished for; desired; sought. · Subject to immediate detainment by law enforcement authorities on sight.
